The '''Cularin Trade Alliance''', or '''CTA''' was an organization that controlled a lot of trade in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The CTA was headed by the [[Vultan]] [[Echari Di'San]], but when he was wrongly arrested for the murder of [[Rysko Barnt]], this threatened the reputation of the company. The company [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]], [[Cyreno Taegon]], hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to find out the truth about Di'San's death and get him freed. They were successful in doing so.

The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Solen Kove]] worked for the company as [[Director/Legends|Director]] of the [[Department of Merchant Safety and Security]] division of the company.
